title: Boston Dynamics appoints former Amazon exec Rohit Prasad as new CEO
key_facts: Boston Dynamics named Rohit Prasad CEO, effective the day after the article (7 Oct 2026).
He succeeds interim CEO and CFO Amanda McMaster, who served after Robert Playter stepped down in February.
Prasad was senior VP and head scientist for Alexa and AGI at Amazon for 12 years and led the Amazon Nova model family.
Boston Dynamics says the appointment accelerates its physical AI strategy.
Subject to the relevant approval process, Prasad is expected to join the board; he is the company's third CEO ever.
Hyundai acquired a controlling stake from SoftBank Group in 2021.
quote_evidence: The company today named Rohit Prasad as its new CEO, effective tomorrow.
Boston Dynamics said Prasad's appointment accelerates its physical AI strategy by combining robotics with advanced AI capabilities to commercialize intelligent machines at scale.
why_it_matters_hint: New CEO from Amazon's Alexa and AI work after nearly nine months with an interim chief.
